display-hero.purpose: Home hero H1 only — the single largest, heaviest step on the site.

display.purpose: Section H2 headings. Bold, tight leading, tight tracking.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, capped by container max-width rather than an explicit ch value.

label.purpose: Uppercase eyebrow labels, nav items, footer column headers. Always wide-tracked.

label-micro.purpose: Photo-caption chips and dense stat sub-labels. Smallest step; never interactive.

shadows.name: floating-dock
shadows.purpose: Header only, once it un-docks and floats on scroll (the Dock Rule).

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Open nav dropdowns, toasts — anything above the base page layer.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveal/hover transitions across Framer Motion sections.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid Signal Green CTA, black text, pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0f0c); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-strong, #58b332); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #58b332); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Transparent, Signal Green border, for secondary actions on light surfaces.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-heading, #0d1410); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--color-accent-soft, #dff3d3); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-strong, #58b332); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: No border or fill; text-only action, Signal Green on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-heading, #0d1410); border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 24px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); }

components.name: Flat Card
components.description: Border-only resting card (ServiceCard). No shadow at rest, per the Dock Rule.
components.html:
⚙

Systems Engineering

Full lifecycle design, from concept through commissioning.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e3e8e3); background: var(--color-paper, #fff); border-radius: 16px; padding: 24px; transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); } .ds-card-badge { clip-path: polygon(25% 6%, 75% 6%, 100% 50%, 75% 94%, 25% 94%, 0% 50%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; background: var(--color-accent-soft, #dff3d3); color: var(--color-accent-strong, #58b332); font-size: 18px; transition: background 0.2s ease, color 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-badge { background: var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); color: var(--color-ink, #0a0f0c); } .ds-card-title { margin-top: 20px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-heading, #0d1410); } .ds-card-body { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--color-body, #576057); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line, #e3e8e3); background: transparent; padding: 10px 0; font-size: 14px; color: var(--color-heading, #0d1410); transition: border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-body, #576057) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: var(--color-accent-strong, #58b332); } .ds-input.error { border-bottom-color: #ef4444; }

components.name: Hex Icon Badge
components.description: The system's signature shape: hexagon-clipped icon container. Appears nowhere except icon badges.
components.css: .ds-badge-hex { clip-path: polygon(25% 6%, 75% 6%, 100% 50%, 75% 94%, 25% 94%, 0% 50%); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; background: var(--color-ink, #0a0f0c); color: var(--color-accent, #6fcf43); }

narrative.overview: Wavelength's interface reads like a technical record of real programmes, not a marketing brochure. It is editorial and documentary: dense horizontal rules, asymmetric column splits, and numbers presented as proof (stat rows, metrics) carry more weight than illustration or ornament. The system trusts restraint — a single accent color, a single typeface, flat surfaces at rest — because the credibility of the work being described (systems that run vessels and plants for decades) would be undercut by a visually loud interface. Density is moderate-to-generous: sections breathe (clamp(80px, 9vw, 112px) vertical rhythm), but within a section, content sits close and rule-divided rather than card-scattered. Depth is used sparingly and only as a state signal.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial ledger structure: rules, splits, and stat rows over decorative cards
One accent color (Signal Green), used sparingly as a functional highlight
Flat surfaces at rest; shadow appears only when something detaches from the page (the Dock Rule)
Single typeface (Geist Sans) doing all display, body, and label work
Hexagon-clipped icon badges as the one recurring signature shape

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green appears on a small minority of any given screen — icon fills, CTAs, dividers, dots. Its rarity is what makes it read as a signal rather than a brand color wash.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Every role — display, body, label — is Geist Sans. A second family is not introduced without an explicit product decision.

rules.name: The Dock Rule
rules.body: A shadow appears only when something detaches from the base page layer: the floating Header, an open dropdown, a toast. Shadow signals a state change, not resting decoration.

rules.name: The Deep-For-Text Rule
rules.body: Signal Green Strong (#58b332) measures 2.66:1 on Paper — fails WCAG AA even at large-text size. Any time the accent colors text sitting on a light surface, use Signal Green Deep (#3b7821, 5.39:1 Paper / 4.96:1 Mist / 4.60:1 Signal Green Soft) instead; Signal Green / Signal Green Strong stay for icon fills, buttons, and text on dark surfaces.

dos: Do keep Signal Green to icon fills, CTAs, dividers, and dots — never a large background fill.
Do use the hexagon clip exclusively for icon badges; it is the system's one signature shape.
Do reserve shadows for elements that detach from the page layer.
Do use rounded-full for every button regardless of variant.
Do prefer editorial rules/splits/stat-rows over decorative card grids for comparisons or proof.
donts: Don't introduce a second typeface without an explicit product decision.
Don't add resting shadows to cards.
Don't treat IndustryCard's shadow-sm ring-1 as a pattern to extend — it's a pre-existing inconsistency.
Don't use gradients; none exist anywhere in the current system.
